edit.description: Add matchesAny coverage for the single-`*` wildcard per spec/pending.md's declared contract.

summary: matchesAny's single-`*` wildcard has zero test coverage anywhere in the suite; every caller (builtinGates.test.ts, Prompt.test.ts) exercises only `**`.

per.section: The entry-scoped write guard is opt-in, and off by default

tests: a declared path with a bare `*` matches only within one path segment, unlike `**`, which crosses `/`
acceptance: paths.test.ts pins matchesAny's `[^/]*` single-star semantics against `**`'s `.*` cross-segment semantics; the new test would fail if `*` were ever implemented as `.*`.
notes: Found sweeping job.ts+paths.ts. matchesAny gates writablePathsGate's real fence enforcement (security-relevant, spec/pending.md line ~288: '`*` and `**` the only wildcards'). Every existing caller uses only `**` patterns, so the single-segment boundary is unverified.
